title: Notifications: one switch, on by default, fired when they start
recommendation: Replace four threshold toggles with one switch "Email me when someone watches a page", on by default, fired at the first view and then at most hourly with how far they got and which buttons they clicked; migrate existing users to on unless they switched every threshold off.

questions.recommended: One. The follow-up email carries the progress.

questions.q: Policy: flip existing users to the new default, so 2,300 customers start receiving "started watching" emails they never opted into?
questions.recommended: Yes, with a one-click "turn off" link in every email and the hourly cap. The ledger shows 23 missed start crossings against 40 emails sent in five days; these are the emails reps asked for.

questions.q: Button clicks: an instant email or inside the hourly email?
questions.recommended: Same rule as views: at once if nothing was sent in the last hour, otherwise in the digest. One rule, one code path.
